headline: Approved job offer to lateral police officer candidate Michelle Royals, pending pre-employment requirements.
summary: The meeting included an executive session to interview a certified police officer candidate, and no votes were taken in that session. In public session, members voted unanimously to extend an employment offer to lateral candidate Michelle Royals, pending completion of pre-employment requirements.
decisions: Approved an employment offer to lateral candidate Michelle Royals, pending successful completion of all pre-employment requirements, by unanimous vote.

decision_titles: Employment offer to lateral candidate Michelle Royals
plain_text:
BOARD OF POLICE COMMISSIONERS 
SPECIAL MEETING 
                                                      AUGUST 24, 2026, AT 6:30 p.m. 
 
 
PRESENT:             ABSENT:  
Mayor Ellen Zoppo-Sassu, Chairperson   Commissioner Rory Ghio          
Commissioner Dean Kilbourne      Commissioner Terry Lewis        
Commissioner Paul Lemieux 
Commissioner Gloria Sapp-Smith 
Council Member Sue Tyler               
 
1. CALL TO ORDER 
Mayor Zoppo-Sassu called the meeting to order at 6:40 P.M. 
 
 
2. TO CONVENE INTO EXECUTIVE SESSION TO INTERVIEW A CERTIFIED 
CANDIDATE FOR THE POSITION OF POLICE OFFICER AND TO TAKE ANY ACTION AS 
NECESSARY. 
Commissioner Kilbourne moved to CONVENE INTO EXECUTIVE SESSION TO INTERVIEW A 
CERTIFIED CANDIDATE, seconded by Commissioner Lemieux.        
 
Present in Executive Session: Mayor Zoppo-Sassu, Commissioners Kilbourne, Lemieux, Sapp-Smith, 
Council Member Tyler, Chief Morello, Deputy Chiefs Moskowitz, Osborne and Lisa Ziogas. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
No votes taken in Executive Session. 
 
3. TO RECONVENE INTO PUBLIC SESSION AND TO TAKE ANY ACTION AS 
NECESSARY.  
Commissioner Kilbourne moved to RECONVENE INTO PUBLIC SESSION, seconded by 
Commissioner Sapp-Smith. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
 
Commissioner Kilbourne moved to  EXTEND AN OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT TO LATERAL 
CANDIDATE MICHELLE ROYALS PENDING SUCCESSFUL COMPLETION OF ALL PRE-
EMPLOYMENT REQUIREMENTS, seconded by Commissioner Lemieux. 
 
               VOTE: UNANIMOUSLY PASSED 
 
4. ADJOURNMENT 
Council Member Tyler moved to ADJOURN, seconded by Commissioner Sapp-Smith. 
 
The regular meeting of the Board of Police Commissioners called for the 24th day of August, 2026, was 
HEREBY ADJOURNED AT 7:20 p.m. 
 
 
                   Lisa Ziogas                   Recording Secretary
